description: This PHP source file defines an abstract class AbstractCandidateActionAPI within the OrangeHRM recruitment module. It provides core functionality for candidate-related API actions, including updating candidate status, managing candidate history, and handling database transactions. It uses traits for auxiliary services and enforces authorization and validation rules. The class is intended to be extended for specific candidate actions, with subclasses defining specific states.

classes.name: AbstractCandidateActionAPI
classes.description: An abstract class providing core API functionalities for candidate actions within the recruitment module. Handles status updates, history logging, transaction management, and enforces validation and authorization. Intended to be extended by concrete classes specifying particular candidate actions.
